title: VIC-II visible-frame parity (RC window, DMA checkpoints, screen-RAM)
body: VIC-II RC/VC state machine matches VICE cycle-accurate behavior (RC window). Native checkpoints validate sprite DMA for all 5 non-PAL models. Screen RAM survives one PAL frame unchanged. VICE viciisc/vicii-cycle.c:541-563, vicii-fetch.c:135-166.
